plain: An action that stirs someone to anger or response

webster.text: Any thing that excites anger; the cause of resentment.

more.text: An appeal to a court or judge.

example.quote: If they should neglect, are we to lend our assistance to compel them by arms, and thus to kindle a civil war without any provocation on their part.
example.cite: Letters of Agrippa I-XI, Massachusetts Gazette, Nov. 1787-Jan. 1788
